[Benzinga news, 2026-10-29T22:02:21Z, by staff] TPG Inc. Raises 2026 Fundraising Guidance
TPG Inc. increased its 2026 fundraising guidance to over $55 billion, supported by record dry powder and strong fundraising activity.
TPG Inc. has raised its fiscal year 2026 fundraising guidance to exceed $55 billion. The firm reported that its assets under management reached $346 billion, with dry powder hitting a record $86 billion. Additionally, the company provided a fee-related earnings (FRE) margin guidance of approximately 48%.
